questions.description: The questions, asked together on one card; the user answers each before it comes back

question.description: What to decide, in one sentence

header.description: A word or two naming the question on the card's tabs, e.g. "Database"

options.description: Up to eight short, distinct choices; the user can always answer in their own words instead

label.description: The choice, in a few words

description.description: What picking it means, in a short line

multiple.description: Let the user pick more than one option
